items.title: Chew some Bubblegum
items.detail: Open a perk card pack or find Bubblegum in Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Build a basic wood or concrete floor at your C.A.M.P., then scrap it.

items.title: Collect Purified Water
items.detail: Collect from a Water Purifier or Vintage Water Cooler at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance.

items.title: Cripple a Blood Eagle's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to The Kill Box and use V.A.T.S. to target the arm with a rifle.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Find masked cultists around cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds during the Slasher event.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Skyline Valley Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Grindstone Arch for a dense group of Super Mutants.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap under Defense in build menu; Punji Board requires 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs and harvest orange bulbs, or plant in C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Visit Giant Teapot for bees or Tanagra Town for Cave Crickets in the giant tree cave.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town bounty board; Slasher appears as final stage boss.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 Cultists; target weak spot on head.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Grab Protest Sign from Grafton or Whitespring, degrade it, repair at workbench with wood.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at Tinker's Workbench and scrap it, or scrap junk containing acid.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs; visit Clancy Manor for decanters.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint under encumbrance limit on open ground; fast travel does not count.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Earn extra caps and face mutated enemy variations in public events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events feature mutated enemy variants with special rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn double experience points across all activities.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72)
events.description: Major update introduces world pets and starts Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Hunt for rare plans and face double mutated enemies for bonus rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Festive seasonal event featuring Holiday Scorched enemies and limited rewards.
